newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up on cargo gains, few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up on cargo gains, few enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were quoted higher on gains in the cargo market, traders said.
A major said prices have edged up, tracking cargo levels. He said enquiries were scarce as the high prices are scaring away buyers.
Bunker 380-cst was indicated at $125-$126 per tonne and 180-cst at $130. The market was very quiet, said a trader.
MDO and gasoil were steady at $222-$226 and $235-$240 respectively.
